nodes.title: Main: answer leaks are zero-visible-failure. A code-built scene never plays while a keyed card or check is live (asking move, or patch 010 itemOpen), never when the live key is unknown (L.held null: fail closed), never while any value is withheld, and never when it shows a held value (sceneShowsHeld, rational equality). Enforced at composeAsk, at the pending slot, at Stagecraft merge, at reveal and on screen.
nodes.reversal: a scene authored with no values and no answer words turns out to be needed during a card (then a scene-level 'valueFree' flag, still never over a word key)

nodes.title: Each pilot scene is a Stagecraft animation archetype scene:<id> (noSpec: never a generated spec; boost: ranked ahead of the topic's Studio v2 animation), built by the instant rung, certified with the scene rule, slotted as a 'scene' artifact. Script-beat scenes (ExplainBeat.scene { topic }, Brain patch 011) wait for the director4 judgement.
nodes.reversal: director4 or the owner find scenes crowd out the live board on explanation beats (then drop boost, keep scenes for asks only)

md.decisions:
### 2026-11-05 Scenes never play over a live card (C1 Studio)
A code-built scene can show a value or word a card asks, so it never comes up while a keyed card or check is live, never when the live key is unknown (fail closed), and never showing a held value (rational equality). It is enforced at every place a scene can appear: compose, pending slot, Stagecraft merge, reveal, and on screen. Reversal: a value-free scene proves necessary during a card.

### 2026-11-05 Stagecraft scene rung (C1 Studio)
The 20 pilot scenes are Stagecraft animation archetypes (no spec builds, $0), ranked ahead of the topic's Studio v2 animation, so a plan-led animation want shows the scene. Script-beat scenes (ExplainBeat.scene) wait for the director4 judgement; the schema patch to Brain (011) is drafted. Reversal: scenes crowd out the live board on explanation beats.
md.measurements:
### 2026-11-05 Scene withholding and rung (C1 Studio, code)
Every value in all 20 pilots' captions, text parts and facts is detected by sceneShowsHeld. Seam cases pass: held key, asking move, card opening while a scene is up, unknown key. The rung reveals scene:equal-parts for an animation want on c4-maths-ch05-t01, never builds a spec for it, and is blocked over a held 1/4. M4 replay unchanged (guard arm: 0 stale, 0.943 at preferred rung).
